map.坡度换算（本页代码口径）：坡度=高差 h÷水平距离 d×100（%）；坡度角=a: Grade conversion (this page): grade = rise h ÷ run d × 100 (%); slope angle = atan(h÷d)×180÷π (°); slope distance = √(h²+d²) (same units); grade ratio 1:m = m (m = d÷h; when h = 0 the ratio is infinite, shown as —). Validation: both fields are required and must be valid numbers, otherwise a message is shown. Criteria: no fixed classification; grade is proportional to rise and inversely proportional to run; 45° corresponds to 100%.

map.由高差与水平距算坡度%。: Compute slope % from rise and horizontal distance.
map.排水管坡 2%：每 100m 降 2m 保证自流，坡太小易淤、太大冲蚀。: Drain pipe slope 2%: drops 2 m per 100 m to ensure gravity flow; too small silts, too large erodes.
map.坡度%=(高差/水平距)×100，分母是水平距不是斜距。: Slope % = (rise/horizontal) × 100, denominator is horizontal not slant.
map.10% 坡=坡比 1:10；坡比=水平:高差，互为倒数关系。: A 10% slope = ratio 1:10; slope ratio = horizontal:rise, reciprocal relation.
